title: Zelensky agrees to US plan for three-way talks with Russia before Christmas
dek: Ukraine's president said the meeting could take place at the G20 summit in Miami in mid-December, as Russian missiles and drones killed two people in Kryvyi Rih and drones hit a ship in the Gulf of Finland.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Saturday that the United States had proposed a new round of three-way peace talks with Russia before Christmas and that he had agreed, suggesting the meeting could be held on the sidelines of the G20 summit in Miami in mid-December.

"The American side said it wanted to organise the meeting before Christmas. I agreed," Mr Zelensky told reporters, according to reports. "The sooner we achieve results, the better." He said Ukrainian security advisers would first hold a series of contacts with their counterparts, by video link or in person, to prepare an agenda and agree what the meeting should produce, and that only then would a date and venue be fixed.

## The G20 question

The G20 leaders' summit is due on 15 and 16 December at President Donald Trump's golf resort near Miami. Mr Zelensky said Ukraine had not been invited, but that "many leaders" had formally asked Washington to invite it and that Ukraine would attend if asked. Asked whether the trilateral meeting could take place at the summit, he said: "I am convinced it is," according to reports.

Mr Trump has reportedly wanted a peace deal to present at the G20, and some members of the US Congress have objected to an invitation to Russia's President Vladimir Putin, according to reports. The Kremlin had not commented publicly on the proposal by Sunday morning IST. Previous rounds of talks this year have not produced a ceasefire.

## Strikes on both sides

The diplomacy came after one of the most intense weeks of air strikes of the war. Two ballistic missiles hit a residential area in the centre of Kryvyi Rih, Mr Zelensky's home city in central Ukraine, on Friday evening, followed by drones while rescuers were at work, said Oleksandr Vilkul, head of the city's defence council. He said a seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old nurse were killed and 47 people injured, 27 of them seriously, including six children. Residential blocks, a hospital and several schools were damaged, according to reports.

Russia's defence ministry said on Saturday that its forces had struck the Kryvyi Rih thermal power plant, an electrical substation in Rivne region in western Ukraine and a cargo ship near Odesa that it said was carrying "dual-use goods" for Ukraine's army. These claims could not be independently verified. The ministry also said its air defences had shot down 275 Ukrainian drones overnight over 11 Russian regions, Crimea and the Black Sea.

In the Russian-controlled part of Ukraine's Luhansk region, the Russian-installed head, Leonid Pasechnik, said the toll from a Ukrainian drone attack on a residential area had risen to six, including a 13-year-old girl. Ukraine did not comment on that claim.

In the Gulf of Finland, two drones hit a cargo ship bound for Russia's Kaliningrad exclave in international waters about three nautical miles from the Russian border, said the governor of Russia's Leningrad region, Alexander Drozdenko, and the crew was evacuated. Estonia's rescue centre identified the vessel as the Sparta II. The origin of the drones has not been officially confirmed. Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo wrote that "Ukraine has the right to respond to the aggressor", and Finland's defence minister said a Russian helicopter may have entered Finnish airspace by up to 4.1 km, possibly during rescue work, according to reports.

## Why it matters for India

India has repeatedly called for the war to be ended through dialogue and diplomacy, and has long-standing energy and defence ties with Russia. A US-brokered settlement, or its failure, will shape oil prices, sanctions on Russian energy and the shipping routes India depends on. Attacks on ships in the Black Sea and the Baltic also push up insurance costs for merchant vessels, including those carrying Indian cargo.

## What happens next

Security advisers from Ukraine and the US are expected to begin preparatory talks in the coming weeks. Whether Russia takes part, and whether Ukraine is invited to Miami, will decide if a meeting can be held before 25 December.
